main_text.l: am : 1 Cor. v, 7, 8. Hebr. xii, 1. 1 Petr. II, 1, 2.
5. In Dei Immutabilitate, constanter incorrupti-
bilitatem & gloriam quæramus: Rom. II, 7.
6. Sic Deum invisibilem requiramus puro corde,
ut ipsum fide videamus, ac tandem ipso fruamur: Jef.
lv, 1, 2, 3, 6. Psal. xvi, 8, 11, 10. Matth. v, 8. Hebr. xi, 17.
7. Desideria nostra piè ad Infinitum illum, atque
Æternum, excitemus, dirigamus; qui solus eâ æter-
num perfectissimè satiare potest: Psal. xlii, 2,
3, xxiii, 1, 3-xvi, 5, 8, 11. xxxvi, 8, 11. 2 Cor. iv, 16,
8. Immensum, nobis semper præsentem, omnia
etiam abstrusissima intime cognoscentium, ex animo
veneramur. Hebr. iv, 11, 13. Psal. cxxxix, 1, 2. 2 Chron.
xxiv, 22. Job. xxi, 23.
9. Ex tenuitatis nostræ circa Dei cognitionem con-
scientiâ humiliemur profundissimè: 1 Cor. xiii, 11,
12. Gal. iv, 8, 9. 2 Petr. I, 19.
10. In Dei Sapientiâ humiliter & piè quæramus
sapientiam veram: Col. iii. 10. Jac. I, 5.
11. Sanctissimæ ipsius Voluntati nostram volunta-
tem subjiciamus & conformemus: Matth. vi, 10. xxvi,
12. Ex Sanctitate, Amore, Gratiâ, Misericordiâ,
Patientiâ, &c. nostram ad eas virtutes analogicam con-
formationem discamus: Levit. xix, 2. Matth. xxii,
13. Omnipotenti ejus manui nos quàm humillimè
submittamus; simulque impotentiam nostram agno-
scentes, omnem adversus hostes nostros spirituales
corroborationem in ipso quæramus: 1 Petr. v, 6. 2 Cor.
xii, 9. Joh. x. 28, 29, Rom. viii, 28.
14. Supremæ Potestati Omnipotentis Dei consci-
entias nostras omnino, & quidem soli, subjiciamus.
Rom. xiv, 9, Jerem. x, 7. Apoc. xv. 4.

page.notes: Scan is a faint, slightly skewed print; some scripture references are uncertain, particularly in paragraphs 7 and 11. Ink smudges at the right margin obscure parts of lines 13-14; the marginal reference marks and fragments near them were not clearly legible.
